name: 4313WX
description: "This bookshelf type speaker system was developed using JBL's professional technology.The low range is equipped with LE111A which is a 25 cm cone type woofer.In the LE111A, JBL's original damping material is applied on the back side of the cone paper to provide optimum mass and rigidity, preventing unwanted resonance of the cone paper and obtaining natural response characteristics.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a 7.5 cm diameter copper ribbon edgewise wound voice coil and 11,000 gauss.The mid-range is equipped with LE5-9 which is a 13 cm cone type skoker.The LE5-9 uses a 2.2 cm diameter copper ribbon edgewise wound voice coil and a 14,000 Gauss magnetic circuit. It has excellent directional characteristics of 150 � at 20 kHz and 90 � at 30 kHz. It also has excellent transient characteristics and greatly reduces distortion.This unit is integrally molded to eliminate surface projections and prevent unwanted reflections.The network section is designed with state-of-the-art technology. It employs an impedance correction circuit that flattens characteristics near the crossover frequency and a phase correction circuit that sharpens sound image localization and prevents phase disturbance between units.We are also working to improve sound quality by using parts such as non-polar capacitors and air-core inductors that have good transient response and high withstand voltage.The middle and high frequencies are equipped with continuously variable level control.A bass reflex system is used for the enclosure and a 19 mm thick rigid particle board is used for the material.The shape and dimensions of the duct are determined by calculating the internal volume of 34 liters to obtain the optimum bass response, and by filling the inside with sufficient sound-absorbing material to prevent the generation of unwanted reflected waves and standing waves.All units are mounted directly on the baffle plate and in-line arrangement improves orientation."

name: 4344M
description: "This speaker system is a bookshelf type middle-size monitor down-sized from JBL's studio monitor 4344 MKII.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.A paper cone is used for the diaphragm, an aluminum die cast frame is used for the frame, and a powerful low distortion magnetic circuit is used for the magnetic circuit.It has a 16 cm cone mid-range in the middle and low range.Paper cone is used for diaphragm, double half roll Cross Edge is used for edge, and aluminum die-cast frame is used for frame.A horn type mid-high is installed in the middle and high area.The driver unit uses a 25 mm pure titanium diaphragm and combines an aluminum die-cast exponential horn with an acoustic lens that expands the pointing area.A 2.5 cm ring-type tweeter is installed in the high range.Pure titanium diaphragm is used for the diaphragm, and high frequency band is radiated from inner / outer horn gap with high density and energy.The network section is equipped with a separate network, which consists of separate circuit boards for the low and middle and low frequencies.The circuit has a low-loss configuration using a bypass capacitor, and the crossover between units is optimized to realize a smooth energy response from low to high frequencies.A continuously variable attenuator volume are equipped with a continuously variable attenuator volume that can adjust the output sound pressure level independently for each band according to the acoustic environment.The enclosure uses a bass-reflex system with twin ports.25 mm thick heavy class MDF material is used for the plate material. For the woofer unit with large cone amplitude, aluminum die-cast clamper is used for 5 point screw tightening, and it is firmly mounted on the baffle surface.The input terminal is divided into two types, one for the low frequency range and the other for the middle and low frequency range or higher.Gold plated speaker terminals are used for connection, bi-wiring connection and passive bi-amplifier drive in addition to normal connection connected by gold plated bus bar."

description: "Professional series large speaker system using newly developed 46 cm woofer.The low band is equipped with a 46 cm cone type Woofer 2245H developed by fusing traditional technology and the latest technology.Compared to the conventional 38 cm cone type woofer, this woofer is not only an expanded cone paper, but also has improved efficiency, linearity, low distortion rate, and other characteristics, enabling superior low-frequency reproduction.The cone section is made of carefully selected materials. In order to optimize mass and rigidity, JBL's original damping agent (Lansa-Plus) is applied to the back side. In addition, JBL's original SFG structure is adopted for the magnetic circuit. The magnetic field in the voice coil gap is symmetrical, and combined with the flux stabilizing ring wound around the pole piece, second harmonic distortion is reduced. In addition, the voice coil has a wide piston motor cortex area of 100 mm diameter and 25 mm length. The linear peak displacement reaches 20 mm. In addition to the heat sink capacity, compression of output at high power is reduced.It is equipped with 2122H of 25 cm cone type woofer in the middle and low range.It uses new cone paper with reduced distortion outside the crossover frequency, and is equipped with 75 mm diameter copper ribbon voice coil, SFG magnetic circuit, etc.The 2122H has a sealed back cavity to prevent interference from other units.The mid-range area is equipped with a horn type mid-range that combines an acoustic lens 2308, horn 2307 and driver unit 2420.The 2308/2307 is a horn lens to be used in combination with a driver with a throat diameter of 2.5 cm. It has the same performance as the 2311/2308 except for the difference in the suitable driver. The mounting dimensions to the baffle and the crossover frequency are also the same. When this horn / lens is mounted on a baffle 30 cm wide x 30 cm high or more, the directivity of horizontal 80 � x vertical 45 � is obtained.Slant Plate 2308 is secured to the front of the baffle by the provided Velcro tape.A horn type tweeter 2405 is installed in the high range.This horn tweeter was developed for wide-range studio monitors. While inheriting JBL's high-efficiency and high-input-resistance characteristics, it realizes a linear response of up to 21.5 kHz and directivity of 140 � horizontal x 40 � vertical (10 kHz).In addition, new technology is incorporated into the ultra-thin ring diaphragm to improve the top-end response.The network section was developed based on JBL's new high-isolation network design. By adding a small-capacitance capacitor to a carefully selected high-capacitance capacitor, the connection of sound is smoothed and transparency is improved.In addition to the 2-channel multi-amp drive at 290 Hz (using channel divider 5234), it is also possible to drive by built-in network.The enclosure uses a 21 mm thick rigid particle board and an asymmetric internal reinforcement to prevent unwanted vibrations such as standing waves. The vertical mirror image pair system enhances sound image localization and sound field reproducibility."

description: "A 4-way floor-type monitor speaker system with inline layout.In the low range, it is equipped with 1500 fe which is 38 cm cone type woofer.Premium Pure Pulp Corn, which is naturally dried, is used for the diaphragm. Lightweight and low-loss EPDM foam rubber is used for the edge and NOMEX double damper with symmetric structure is used for the damper.Equipped with JBL's unique bent-gap cooling mechanism that effectively releases heat from the voice coil, it realizes high linearity in response to continuous high power drive.A 25 cm cone mid-bus unit, 2251J-1, is installed in the middle and low range.This unit uses a fiber composite cone in pursuit of low distortion and power handling. The magnetic circuit uses a neodymium differential drive (NDD) system, and has a dual-gap, dual-voice coil structure with a large diameter neodymium ring magnet sandwiched between two pole pieces.A horn type mid-high using 7.5 cm driver unit 435 al is mounted in the middle and high area.Aluminum diaphragm, voice coil with lightweight aluminum ribbon wire, magnetic circuit with high-flux neodymium magnet, face plug with rapid-flare type used by JBL Professional Unit.The horn section uses a constant coverage biradial horn manufactured by SonoGlass with 90 � horizontal x 40 � vertical directivity.045 ti which is a 2.5 cm driver unit is mounted in the high range.The diaphragm is equipped with a pure titanium diaphragm with an integrally molded edge and a lightweight aluminum ribbon voice coil wrapped around it. The magnetic circuit is also equipped with a high-flux neodymium magnet, which provides high sensitivity, high output, and high durability.The horn is a 60 � horizontal x 40 � vertical constant coverage biradial horn manufactured by SonoGlass integrated with an attenuator panel.The network section has a separate and independent structure for LF and MF to UHF.In addition to using high-quality parts for the network elements, jBL's unique charge-coupled linear definition system is adopted, and nonlinear distortion is eliminated by applying a DC bias to the capacitor.In addition, it is equipped with an MF/HF/UHF independent and continuously variable attenuator.Inline layout is adopted for the unit layout, and excellent sound image localization and sound field reproduction capability are obtained by placing each unit on the vertical line at the center of the enclosure.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system. The board is made of 25 mm thick highly rigid MDF material, and the front baffle is 44 mm thick for additional strength. In addition, the horn unit and network of Mid high and Ultra high are housed in independent sub-cavities. The upper and lower parts are divided into two separate structures. The network is established from the powerful magnetic circuit of U f, and electromagnetic interference is eliminated. The sub-cavity has a structure that has almost no effect on the total reproduction frequency characteristics even when the ring is removed.The exterior is finished with a walnut veneer finish. In addition, the front baffle uses the traditional blue baffle on the lower side to match the separate structure enclosure, and the upper side is dark gray to harmonize with the horn color.The grill is a separate type, and the top and bottom can be attached and removed separately.There are two sets of speaker terminals for bi-wiring connection and active bi-amplifier drive by switching modes."

description: "A speaker system developed for recording, mixdown and mastering in large studios where high sound pressure levels are required.All performance levels such as input resistance, frequency response, distortion and dynamic range are uncompromised, and clear sound localization and sound field reproducibility are obtained by the mirror image pair configuration of left and right channel symmetry.In the low range, it is equipped with 2 pieces of 2235H which are 38 cm cone type woofer.This unit adopts the basic design common to 2234H, such as SFG magnetic circuit with low distortion factor, strong cone with high compliance edge, long voice coil with winding width of 19 mm, and reinforced suspension, and realizes low distortion factor and high input resistant characteristics.In addition, a mass control ring is added to the vibration system of the 2235H, which lowers fo and increases the rigidity of the vibration system base, and the low-end regenerative capability is further expanded than that of the 2234H.It is equipped with 2202H which is a 30 cm cone type woofer in the middle and low range.This unit uses a strong magnetic circuit equivalent to a 38 cm woofer, giving it excellent power for SR.The mid-range area is equipped with a horn type mid-range combining a 2441 driver, a 2311 horn and a 2308 lens.The 2441 is a large compression driver based on the 375 used in commercial sound systems. It combines a powerful magnetic circuit of an Alnico V magnet with a diamond suspension diaphragm. Despite being a large diameter driver with a 5 cm throat, it smoothly expands the response up to 18 khz. In addition, the diamond suspension has the same quality and reliability as a roll edge, yet achieves linearity better than a tangential edge. Aluminum ribbon is used for the voice coil.The 2308 is a compact horn lens designed for large 5-cm throat drivers. The Shortcut Exponential Horn 2311 is made of cast aluminum. The Slant Plate 2308 is an acoustic lens that forms an 80 � horizontal x 45 � vertical directional pattern and is fixed to the front of the baffle with Velcro tape. The horn lens is ideal for playback within 10m range.A horn type tweeter, 2405H, is installed in the high frequency range.This unit is a split-horn tweeter developed for wide-range studio monitors. While inheriting JBL's high-efficiency and high-input-resistance characteristics, it realizes a linear response of up to 21.5 khz and directivity of 140 Ï‰ horizontally x 40 Ï‰ vertically (10 khz).The enclosure uses a bass reflex system, and the mid-woofer is housed in a special chamber to eliminate interference with the woofer.The exterior is a walnut oil finish and comes with a dark blue grill.The 4355 is designed exclusively for bi-amplifier drive, and the low-frequency and mid-low frequencies and above are independent inputs.To split the frequency between the woofer and mid-woofer, use an optional 5234A (or 5234) channel divider and a 290 hz, 18dB/oct. crossover card (51 to 5145).Mid-woofer and higher levels can be adjusted with 5234A, and the driver and tweeter can be adjusted individually with the main body attenuator."

name: 4425MKII
description: "A refined model of the 4425 released in 1985.While keeping the original design concept as it is, we technology accumulated through the development of Project K2 and 4344 MKII is introduced.1200H, a 30 cm cone type unit, is used for the low range.K2 series technology has been introduced, and fiber composite cone made by mixing glass fiber with pulp paper is adopted.In addition, by applying a unique Aqua Plus coating on the surface of the cone, both the rigidity that suppresses the generation of split vibration and the damping effect that smoothly connects sound in the crossover region are achieved.In addition, a 3-inch diameter, edgewise wound voice coil and newly designed large damper are adopted to improve linearity and power handling.In addition, by creating a symmetric magnetic field in the voice coil gap and using an SFG (symmetrical filtered geometry) magnetic circuit that reduces second harmonic distortion, we have achieved medium and low frequency characteristics with less distortion.The frame uses a high-strength aluminum die-cast with a direct penting system that efficiently releases the sound pressure to the rear of the suspension.A 2-inch 175 nd compression driver and a bi-radial horn are used for the high frequency band.The driver is equipped with a pure titanium diaphragm, and by adopting a unique diamond structure edge, resonance between the diaphragm and the edge is eliminated to ensure free movement of the diaphragm.In addition, it is stored in the back housing made of high-strength aluminum die-cast, and the back pressure of the diaphragm is well received.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a high-flux neodymium magnet and has an inner magnetic structure with high magnetic conduction efficiency. In addition, a Ferrofluid cooling mechanism is used to inject magnetic fluid into the voice coil gap to effectively dissipate the heat generated in the voice coil, thereby increasing the input resistance.The horn section is equipped with a new-generation bi-radial horn that provides 100 � constant directivity in both horizontal and vertical directions over a wide band. It can be applied widely from near distance monitoring to middle distance monitoring.A special resin is used for the horn material. Through analysis and processing using a computer, the shape and thickness of the horn are precisely controlled in details from the throat to the opening, and a high degree of perfection has been achieved by eliminating horn squeal and coloring.Based on the biased network technology established in the K2 Series, it employs a high-quality dividing network composed of carefully selected passive parts.It is equipped with a low-frequency network with high transient characteristics and a high-frequency network with serial / parallel combinations of capacitors. The low-frequency network is equipped with multiple capacitors with different dielectric constant and structure in parallel to eliminate inherent colorization. The high-frequency network is equipped with a combination of capacitors in series / parallel.In addition, the separate arrangement of independent boards eliminates electromagnetic coupling between networks.In addition, we have succeeded in eliminating 0 cross distortion and improving sound resolution and transient characteristics by adopting a charge-coupled linear definition method that adds DC bias to the high-frequency network and making the capacitor perform class A operation.It is equipped with a continuously variable network capable of adjusting the high frequency level.The high-frequency and low-frequency gold-plated speaker inputs allow for bi-wiring connection and bi-amplifier drive.The enclosure is grouped in the same baffle size and floor size as the 4425 for ease of replacement.A 19 mm thick particle board is used for the material, and reinforcement is placed inside.MDF material is used for the baffle plate, smooth curved surface is applied to the opening of the bass reflex port, and finished with gray black paint of the same color as horn.In addition, with an emphasis on interior design, the exterior is finished with a 5-sided wallnut board."

description: "A middle-size studio monitor speaker system that inherits the technology of high-end machines.The low range is equipped with 1200FE-8 which is 30 cm cone type woofer.This unit is a 1200 fe impedance of 8 � specification used for Project K2S 5800.The diaphragm uses Kevlar composite cone which increases the strength of the diaphragm by mixing Kevlar fiber with pulp material, and in addition, JBL's unique Aqua Plus coating is applied.In addition, we have adopted a double damper for increasing linearity, an aluminum die-cast frame for the frame, a new symmetrical field geometry (SFG) magnetic circuit and an aluminum ribbon edgewise wound voice coil for low-distortion, high-reality low-frequency reproduction that does not move even in high-power drives.The high range is equipped with a horn type mid-range which combines a 5.0 cm driver unit 175Nd-2 and an HF/UHF combination horn.Pure titanium diaphragm with Aqua Plus coating is used for the diaphragm, and rapid flare exit method with low distortion is used for the phase plug.The magnetic circuit uses a lightweight aluminum ribbon voice coil and neodymium magnet. By sealing magnetic fluid in the voice coil gap, the heat generated by the voice coil is cooled and power handling is improved.A horn type tweeter combining a 015M 1.9 cm ring type tweeter and an HF/UHF combination horn is mounted in the ultra-high band.A polyimide diaphragm is used for the diaphragm, and by integrating the diaphragm and bobbin, the vibration system mass is reduced and transmission loss is suppressed.A bullet-shaped center equalizer is mounted on the front of the diaphragm to limit the attenuation of high-frequency energy due to phase interference.A combination horn made by SonoGlass is used for the high-pass and ultra-high-pass horns. By using an integrated combination horn, the performance of each driver is brought out and the acoustic connection is improved. The directivity angle is 60 � horizontal x 40 � vertical for the ultra-high-pass and 90 � horizontal x 40 � vertical for the high-pass.This horn has an integrated structure with the upper baffle.A separate network is used for the network section, and the network circuits for the low band and for the high band or higher are separated and independent.High-quality parts such as air-core coils and polypropylene film capacitors are used in the device.A continuously variable attenuator is installed in the high and ultra high frequencies.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The unit layout adopts an inline method in which units are arranged on a vertical line, and the sound image is positioned more clearly.High-rigidity MDF material of 25 mm thickness is used for the plate material. In addition, round processing is applied to the symmetrical twin bass reflex port to suppress the breathing of the port.The input terminal uses a gold-plated speaker terminal for bi-wiring connection.There was a special speaker stand as an option sold separately."

name: CENTURYGOLD
description: "This speaker system was developed as a 50th anniversary model of JBL with the theme of the new century standard.The Century1200, a 30 cm cone shaped woofer, is installed in the low range.This unit adopts the technology of K2, the highest peak of the JBL floor type, and uses composite cone mixed with fiberglass. The unique Aqua Plus coating on the surface realizes excellent rigidity and damping.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a symmetrical field geometry (SFG) magnetic circuit to prevent magnetic distortion and improve the heat radiation effect of the voice coil.In addition, a direct-bending type aluminum die-cast frame is used to efficiently release the sound pressure to the rear of the suspension.The mid-range is equipped with a 12.5 cm cone-shaped mid-range Century500.This unit uses Kevlar cone, which boasts light weight and high strength, and composite edge, which has elasticity and flexibility by combining rubber and vinyl to improve dynamic range.The voice coil uses a 50 mm aluminum edgewise wound voice coil to improve linearity and input resistance. The magnetic circuit uses a low-mass, high-flux neodymium magnet, a center-pole-bent back plate with a high heat radiation effect, and a newly designed bucket-shaped frame with excellent transient characteristics to achieve high stability.The high-pass band is equipped with 050 ti gold, a 2.5 cm dome tweeter.The diaphragm uses an edge molded titanium diaphragm, and metal fatigue is reduced by a unique cold metal drawing method. This titanium diaphragm is plated with 24 gold along with the face plate, and smooth high-frequency characteristics are obtained by giving appropriate damping to the metal surface.By setting the crossover frequency of the woofer and mid-range to 600 Hz in the network section, the frequency range of the vocal band is covered by the R screw and wide directivity is realized. The mid-range and tweeter have excellent characteristics with less peak / dip due to the slope characteristic of -18dB/oct.High-quality network parts are used. LF (low-frequency) networks emphasize current characteristics and transient characteristics and use three types of small-capacity capacitors with different electrical characteristics and structures in parallel. MF-HF (medium-high frequency) networks use a combination of small-capacity capacitors in parallel / series and a charge-coupled linear definition system with DC bias applied to the capacitors. This enables class A operation of the capacitors to eliminate 0 cross distortion and improve sound quality and characteristics.The LF and MF-HF networks are physically as well as electrically separated and arranged orthogonally on independent boards to minimize electromagnetic coupling between network circuits.The enclosure uses a 19 mm thick body and 25 mm thick baffle MDF with a metal plate at the top of the baffle and rounded left and right sides to prevent diffuse sound reflection at the edges.The exterior features a natural mahogany veneer finish on all six sides of the enclosure and a signature plate on the back of Greg Timbers, the Chief Systems Engineer who delivered the most representative JBL speakers, including the Everest, K2 and S2600/S3100, as proof of the JBL 50th anniversary model.The front grill uses a metal frame grill with a plastic coating on a small-area steel bar, and acoustic interference of the grill is eliminated by attaching and detaching the floating structure.In addition, the grill is designed to cover only woofer, mid-range and bass reflex ports. description: "This is the first large speaker system of Project Everest that was developed as a speaker that transcends the eternal masterpiece Paragon.The DD55000 was designed and developed by a project team based on the two major themes of expanding the service area of accurate stereo images and greatly expanding the dynamic range. name: HLS610
description: "HLS series speaker system.The HLS610 is a speaker system slightly smaller than the HLS810.A 13.3 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.Polypropylene cone is used for the diaphragm, and newly developed co-injection molding technology is introduced. By fusing and integrating the cone and rubber edge, the acoustic loss generated at the joint with the edge is reduced.A combination of a 1 cm dome tweeter and a constant directivity horn is installed in the high range.A polycarbonate dome is used for the vibration plate of the tweeter, and a ferrofluid cooling mechanism with magnetic fluid injected into the voice coil gap improves cooling efficiency and ensures high input resistance that can withstand high-power drives.The constant directivity horn is designed to solve the problem that high frequency characteristics are degraded at off-axis positions. It accurately controls the high frequency range radiated from the tweeter with a horn with constant directivity. Even at off-axis positions, it can listen with the same frequency balance as on the axis. In addition, since the sound does not wrap around or reflect on the ceiling or wall outside the listening area, the original sound of the source can be heard more accurately. It also contributes to improving the efficiency of the tweeter.It has a magnetic shield design.The enclosure uses a rear bass reflex system.It adopts a rear bass reflex system with a bass reflex port on the back, and the sound is optimized at a position where the speaker is at least 5 cm away from the rear wall surface.In addition, in order to eliminate the effect of resonance on sound, precision reinforcement and assembly are carried out using original simulation analysis capable of cutting to 1 micron precision, and panel vibration is reduced to 1 / 10 compared with conventional products, eliminating the occurrence of colorization.The speaker terminal uses a binding post type corresponding to a banana plug."

name: L110
description: "This bookshelf type speaker system was developed by inheriting studio monitor technology.A 25 cm cone type woofer LE111A is mounted in the low range.This unit has a unique compound coating on the underside of the cone paper to provide robustness and moderate internal losses, resulting in optimum mass, high efficiency and low sound reproduction.The voice coil uses a 7.6 cm diameter copper ribbon edgewise winding, which increases the number of windings compared to conventional voice coils, resulting in improved efficiency, transient response, and input resistance. The magnetic circuit uses an Alnico V magnet to narrow the gap and concentrate the magnetic force on the voice coil.This woofer is responsible for frequencies below 1 kHz, but in reality, it has a smooth response even in frequencies above 3 kHz, making the connection with the Skoker natural.13 cm cone type Skoka LE5-10 is mounted in the middle area.The precision design 2.2 cm diameter voice coil and high magnetic flux density magnetic circuit improve the efficiency and transient characteristics in the mid-frequency range. The hard material used for the cone paper, which emits sound, prevents deformation at the maximum instantaneous input. The aluminum center dome gives the Skokcar itself the ability to reproduce up to the high frequency band and improves the connection with the tweeter.In addition, the internal volume is calculated in consideration of the sound connection with the woofer, and mounted in a completely sealed back cavity filled with an appropriate amount of sound absorbing material to prevent interference with the woofer.It is equipped with a 2.5 cm dome type tweeter 033 capable of high-frequency reproduction of 30 kHz or more.For the dome part, two sheets of linen cloth impregnated with phenol resin are bonded together so that the weaves intersect at an angle of 45 � for weight reduction and durability. In addition, the voice coil is 2.5 cm, the same diameter as the dome, and it is large for high sound, so that excellent transient response and input resistance characteristics are obtained.In addition, the dome is securely fixed by a unique clamping ring to prevent external resonance.The network section is equipped with state-of-the-art impedance correction and phase correction circuits, as well as high-quality parts such as air-core inductors, capacitors with superior characteristics, and resistors.It is equipped with continuously variable level control for middle and high frequencies.High-density compression agent with excellent plate vibration is used for the enclosure, and especially thick 25 mm plate is used for the baffle plate to prevent distortion of sound image at high output. Sufficient sound absorbing material is filled inside to absorb standing wave.The speaker units are mounted in a straight line, avoiding the center, so that the connection between the units is smooth and sound image localization is improved.The exterior has a walnut finish."

name: L220
description: "This floor-type speaker system incorporates JBL's studio monitor speaker technology and new technology.By aligning the sound source positions of each unit in the L220, the arrival time of the sound emitted from each sound source to the front baffle is kept equal. The sound emitted from these units is guided to a single flat front baffle and radiated, preventing unnecessary reflection and enabling sound radiation with excellent phase characteristics.In addition, the unit layout is arranged in a vertical line to obtain a uniform sound source, thereby realizing more accurate sound image localization.In the low range, it is equipped with LE14A which is a 36 cm cone shaped woofer which is also adopted in L101.JBL's traditional Alnico V magnet is used for the magnetic circuit of this unit. The 10.2 cm voice coil is edgewise wound with copper ribbon wire. The LE14A voice coil has a large diameter relative to the diameter, so it has excellent transient response and efficiency.For low-frequency use, it is equipped with a passive radiator PR15C, 38 cm in diameter, which is the same as the Olympus S508.PR15C 5C is highly compliant and approximately 30% larger than the woofer, the LE14A is used in combination with the PR15C to improve the low-frequency response.The middle area is equipped with LE5-9 of 13 cm cone type skoker.To prevent interference from the woofer, it is housed in a separate chamber and mounted with a sub-baffle plate behind the main baffle plate.The sub-baffle is equipped with a special acoustic lens in front of the sub-baffle. The acoustic lens guides the sound emitted from the squaker to the main baffle surface and diffuses it at an ideal angle.A horn type tweeter 076 is installed in the high range.The 076 is an elliptical horn type unit that uses a ring diaphragm unique to JBL. It has a structure that connects a phasing plug that keeps phase and amplitude constant to an exponential horn with an elliptical cross section to control directional characteristics. It is also designed so that the sound source of the tweeter is aligned with other units.The network has built-in impedance equalization and phase correction circuits designed to prevent peak-dip and phase distortion near the crossover frequency of each speaker unit.The front of the enclosure is a pick-trapezoid floor, providing sufficient strength while minimizing floor space.In addition, the exterior is a traditional hand-polished black walnut material."

description: "A Tik series floor-type speaker system with a unique round enclosure.The low range is equipped with 806G-1 which is a 16.5 cm cone type unit used for the middle and low range of Ti10K.A polypropylene coated cone is used for the diaphragm, and an injection molded edge that is integrally molded with the cone is used for the edge part.In addition, SFG (geometry (SFG) magnetic circuit with shortening that employs a 20 cm unit class large diameter 50 mm voice coil, a tapered cooling vent, and a photosynthetic aluminum die-cast frame.Ti025K which is a 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is mounted in the high range.The diaphragm uses JBL's original pure titanium diaphragm. name: SG620
description: "A preamplifier that integrates JBL sound policy and circuit technology.As a control center, the SG620 is designed to satisfy all types of input signals and to improve sound quality.Class A push-pull operation is adopted for all stages of the MC head amplifier.The first stage, which handles input signals, consists of large low-noise devices connected in parallel, and is DC-coupled so as not to degrade sound quality.The first stage of the Phono amplifier has high input impedance to minimize distortion for any input. The variable switch of input resistance and input capacitance can be used for all MM cartridges.The equalizer stage is made up of a semi-passive filter for dynamic distortion to achieve a wide dynamic range. In addition, a subsonic filter is installed between the first stage and the equalizer stage to cut out the harmful 3 to 7 Hz band below the audible frequency that occurs during disc playback.The high-level amplifier uses a class A push-pull and complimentary service configuration. The first stage uses a unique floating cascode connection using a high-speed dual FET to realize a response with good linearity.The tone control circuit is located inside the high-level amplifier and consists of only passive elements.The adjustment is step-by-step and the tone circuit is completely lost when set to the flat position.A symmetrical low-noise device with excellent regulation is used for the power supply section to provide a stable power supply to each block.Gold-plated connectors and contacts are used to reduce aging degradation and contact strain.The gain of the MC head amplifier, the input resistance of the equalizer stage, and the input capacitance can be changed.It is also equipped with control functions such as changing the loudness sensitivity and using a processor circuit."

name: SA640
description: "This is a stereo power amplifier that uses JBL's original T-circuit technology.It adopts T-type circuit which is JBL's original circuit technology.This method was developed by JBL in the early days of transistor amplifiers. It is essentially a symmetrical circuit with a pure complimentary service configuration with excellent linearity and basic performances. The SA640 adopts this method while using the latest devices to further improve sound quality.A 3-stage Darlington pure complimentary service push-pull T-type circuit is used.In addition, by composing the summing point of the NF circuit with passive elements, stable operation with good linearity is realized even for large input.In addition, the sound quality and characteristics have been improved by using the latest high-quality parts for all parts including the high-speed device adopted in the first stage.The power supply section uses a large EI transformer with excellent regulation and a 40,000 Ï‰ F large-capacity capacitor to provide stable sound even when ultra-low-frequency transient signals are input.In addition, this condenser uses a high-precision condenser developed for computers to improve sound quality and characteristics that do not appear in specifications.Large heat sinks on both sides effectively dissipate heat generated by the power transistor.In addition, we have adopted a temperature protection circuit that also serves as a delay circuit to prevent shock noise from the preamplifier when the power is ON. Thus, no additional circuit is added to the output to improve sound quality and characteristics.From precision metal-coated resistors and high-precision power capacitors to printed circuit boards, we have carefully selected products with an emphasis on sound quality."

description: "An automatic microphone mixer developed using JBL's original electronic technology.Equipped with 4-channel microphone input, it can be expanded up to 24 channels in 4-channel unit by adding separately sold modular unit 7510-01.The input is a balanced type with 48 v phantom power supply function for condenser microphone.It has a floating output, a direct output (unbalanced, 24 channels maximum) for supplying each input signal to an external effector device, and an auxiliary input (unbalanced, 1 channel maximum) for receiving the return signal from an external effector device.The 7510 is designed to function as a normal manual mixer when the toggle switch on the panel is in the ON position, and to display its true value in the AUTO or PRIORITY position.In the AUTO position, the digital logic circuit constantly compares the input common to all microphones (background noise) with the input to a specific microphone (signal sound), and operates only the desired channels. The digital logic circuit automatically controls the gain so that the output level remains constant regardless of the number of active channels. This allows a constant feedback margin to be maintained without dynamic range fluctuations or breathing, which cannot be avoided with conventional compressors and mixers. The rise time is 30 ms to 60 ms, reducing the influence on the rise of the local music signal. The threshold level is adjustable.In the PRIORITY position, the channel set to this position takes precedence over other channels. This allows the chairman's remarks to be delivered in a meeting with priority over other channels.It can be used as a high-speed, high-fidelity noise gate for multi-microphone recording. It can also be used as a concert SR to increase the system gain up to howling, and it can be used as a preset without adjustment."
